requires: @nebutra/agent-runtime for orchestration grammar and runtime policy
@nebutra/agents for injected model execution and fallback routing
@nebutra/ui and @nebutra/icons for shared Startup OS presentation metadata
gaps: Dashboard-facing adapters are still wired through app routes
Product flows still depend on the host app for auth, billing, and tenant lifecycle
Durable multi-run orchestration is still delegated to adjacent runtime packages
File and canvas operations are runtime contracts, not a standalone production surface
nebutra.summary: Startup OS product orchestration contracts for company context, founder conversation, execution, files, rollout, canvas state, and model-tier decisions
